locations.name: SEC Centre
locations.setting: Exhibition and conference centre on the Clyde in Glasgow, alongside the SSE Hydro concert arena, with large column-free halls used for events and filming.
locations.facilities: Five interconnected exhibition and event halls with a combined area of over 22,000 sq m.

locations.name: Segedunum Roman Fort
locations.setting: The excavated remains of a Roman fort at Wallsend marking the eastern end of Hadrian's Wall, with a reconstructed bathhouse, viewing tower and museum.
locations.suitability: Part of the North East Museums group, which states it welcomes film, television and photography companies to hire its venues

locations.name: Shepton Mallet Prison
locations.setting: Former English prison dating to 1610, closed in 2013, with cell wings, exercise yards and a gatehouse now hired as an events and filming venue.

locations.name: Shrewsbury Prison
locations.setting: A closed Victorian prison on The Dana in Shrewsbury, with wings, cells and exercise yards intact from its use until 2013.
locations.suitability: Production and film location hire listed as a dedicated service alongside tours and ghost events

locations.name: Silverstone Circuit
locations.setting: A motor racing circuit on a former airfield in Northamptonshire, with grandstands, pit garages and a test track hired for motoring productions.

locations.name: Snape Maltings
locations.setting: Former Victorian malting complex on the River Alde, its brick maltings and kilns converted into a concert hall, galleries and shops.

locations.name: Somerset House
locations.setting: Neoclassical courtyard building on the Strand with a fountain court and river terrace, hired for events and productions in central London.
locations.facilities: Multiple spaces for hire: the Edmond J. Safra Fountain Court (3,000 capacity), Embankment Galleries (800), River Terrace (500), West Wing (500), Portico Rooms/Seamen's Hall/Lightwells & Deadhouse (200 each), Navy Board Rooms (100) and Screening Room (70).

locations.name: Southwold Pier
locations.setting: Traditional seaside pier rebuilt in the 2000s on its Edwardian footings, with a pavilion, amusement arcade and end-of-pier walkway over the North Sea.

locations.name: SS Great Britain
locations.setting: Preserved Victorian iron-hulled steamship in her original dry dock in Bristol, with restored decks, engine room and dockside museum buildings.

locations.name: SS Nomadic
locations.setting: Restored 1911 tender ship in Belfast's Hamilton Dock, the last remaining vessel of the White Star Line, moored beside Titanic Belfast as a museum ship.

locations.name: St George's Bristol
locations.setting: A deconsecrated Georgian church on Brandon Hill in Bristol converted into a concert hall, its columned interior hired for recordings, filming and events.

locations.name: St George's Market
locations.setting: Late Victorian covered market hall in Belfast, a red brick and steel structure with market stalls, used for markets, events and filming when not trading.

locations.name: SWG3
locations.setting: A converted warehouse and former whisky bond in Glasgow's Yorkhill, now a multi room venue used for music, events and film and television production.

locations.name: The Bluecoat
locations.setting: Britain's oldest surviving purpose-built arts centre, a Grade I listed early Georgian charity school building in central Liverpool with galleries, a courtyard and function rooms.

locations.name: The Historic Dockyard Chatham
locations.setting: 80-acre former Royal Navy dockyard on the Medway with Georgian ropewalks, covered slips, dry docks and historic ships used as period maritime backdrops.
locations.suitability: Both interior and exterior locations are offered, including No. 3 Slip, the Tarred Yarn Store, the Ropery exterior, Anchor Wharf, and cobbled Victorian streets, suited to period productions.

locations.name: The O2 Belfast
locations.setting: An indoor arena in the Odyssey complex on Belfast's Queen's Quay, home to ice hockey and concerts, with a bowl and function spaces for hire.

locations.name: The Old Truman Brewery
locations.setting: Former East End brewery complex on Brick Lane with converted vat rooms, yards and warehouse floors hired as event and shoot space.

locations.name: The Piece Hall
locations.setting: Grade I listed 18th century cloth hall in Halifax, a colonnaded stone quadrangle of former merchants' rooms around a large open square, now shops, bars and an events space.

locations.name: The Sharp Project
locations.setting: A converted industrial estate in north Manchester built as television and digital production studios, with offices, a yard and outdoor space for crews and vehicles.

locations.name: The Tank Museum
locations.setting: Military vehicle museum on the Bovington army camp with several hundred tanks and armoured vehicles, indoor halls and outdoor arena space.

locations.name: Thinktank, Birmingham Science Museum
locations.setting: A science museum at Millennium Point in Birmingham with galleries of steam engines, vehicles and interactive exhibits across four floors, available for venue hire.

locations.name: Titanic Belfast
locations.setting: A six floor angular aluminium clad museum on the Belfast slipway where the Titanic was built, with galleries and function spaces hired for events.

locations.name: Tobacco Dock
locations.setting: A Grade I listed early nineteenth century dock warehouse in Wapping, with exposed brick vaults and cast iron columns hired as an events space.

locations.name: Tower Bridge
locations.setting: Bascule and suspension bridge over the Thames with twin Victorian Gothic towers and a glass-floored high-level walkway overlooking the city.
locations.known_for: The Mummy Returns, Spider-Man: Far From Home
locations.facilities: Interior filming spaces include the High-Level Walkways (level 5), the North and South Towers and the Engine Rooms; a Film Liaison team, on-site security and on-site catering are available.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography applications (inside the attraction, on the bridge pavements, on Tower Bridge Road, or in the airspace around the bridge) are made through the FilmApp portal and need at least 5 working days to process. Drones are strictly prohibited within a 50m perimeter for the general public; commercial drone requests are considered case by case with safety protocols. Post-production additions implying the Bridge endorses a brand are not supported. Photography of the Bridge from public space is allowed without permission under Freedom of Panorama.

locations.name: Trades Hall of Glasgow
locations.setting: Robert Adam designed 18th century guild hall in central Glasgow, with a domed saloon and panelled function rooms still used by the city's trade incorporations.

locations.name: Trinity Buoy Wharf
locations.setting: Former lighthouse testing wharf at the mouth of the River Lea, with a lightship, converted shipping-container studios and dockside sheds.

locations.name: Troxy
locations.setting: A former 1930s cinema in Limehouse converted into an events venue, its art deco auditorium and foyers hired for filming, television and live shows.

locations.name: Two Temple Place
locations.setting: Neo-Gothic mansion built for William Waldorf Astor beside the Thames, with a galleried great hall and carved wood interiors offered for filming.
locations.suitability: Offers 'Filming & Photoshoots' as part of its venue hire service; pricing, capacities and floorplans are provided by the venue hire team on request.

locations.name: Ulster Transport Museum
locations.setting: A National Museums NI transport museum at Cultra on Belfast Lough, with halls of trains, cars and aircraft beside the adjoining Ulster Folk Museum's historic buildings.

locations.name: Union Chapel
locations.setting: A working Victorian Gothic chapel in Islington that doubles as a music venue, its galleried octagonal interior hired for filming and concerts.

locations.name: University of Salford
locations.setting: A university campus beside MediaCityUK on Salford Quays, with lecture theatres, media production studios and modern teaching buildings.

locations.name: Utilita Arena Birmingham
locations.setting: Indoor arena in central Birmingham seating several thousand, used for concerts, sport and other large events at the NEC Group's city centre site.

locations.name: V&A Dundee
locations.setting: Waterfront design museum on the Dundee riverside with a stacked-stone exterior by architect Kengo Kuma, opened in 2018 beside the historic ship RRS Discovery.

locations.name: Verdant Works
locations.setting: A restored nineteenth century jute mill in Dundee with original machinery and mill buildings, run as a museum of the city's textile industry.

locations.name: Victoria Baths
locations.setting: Disused Edwardian public baths in Manchester with three original pools, a Turkish suite and stained glass, hired as a filming location since its closure in 1993.

locations.name: W5
locations.setting: An interactive science discovery centre inside the Odyssey complex on Belfast's Queen's Quay, with exhibition floors and workshop spaces.

locations.name: Wales Millennium Centre
locations.setting: Steel and slate clad performing arts centre on Cardiff Bay, with a main theatre, studio spaces and a bronze-lettered curved facade.

locations.name: Westonbirt, The National Arboretum
locations.setting: A Forestry England arboretum in Gloucestershire with thousands of labelled trees, formal avenues and a treetop walkway.

locations.name: Wilton's Music Hall
locations.setting: Surviving Victorian music hall in Wapping with a barley-twist column auditorium and worn brick backstage areas, hired for filming and photography.
locations.facilities: Victorian rooms and spaces including the main stairway, the Cocktail Bar and the main Hall, plus the auditorium, Mahogany Bar and The Study. On-site production offices, dressing rooms and wardrobe facilities can be hired, with technical staff able to advise on power and setup; additional crew is available for an extra charge.

locations.name: Winter Gardens Blackpool
locations.setting: A Victorian entertainment complex in Blackpool covering almost five acres, with the domed Spanish Hall, an opera house and function rooms hired for events.

locations.name: Woodhorn Museum
locations.setting: A former colliery near Ashington in Northumberland with preserved pithead buildings, a winding engine and headstocks, run as a mining heritage museum.
locations.suitability: Part of the North East Museums group, which states it welcomes film, television and photography companies to hire its venues

locations.name: Wookey Hole
locations.setting: A show cave complex in the Mendip Hills near Wells, with limestone chambers, an underground river and an attached Victorian paper mill.

locations.name: Wrest Park
locations.setting: Country house near Silsoe built in French chateau style, set within formal gardens with canals, pavilions and woodland walks.
